description: Paid ($0.05, x402 v2 exact). Returns allow / escalate / block with reasons, evidence and a verifiable receipt. Single-check validation errors return INPUT_ERROR before payment and incur no charge. Checks require EVM-format recipient addresses. XNO on nano:mainnet can pay for checks where enabled. A Nano-format recipient returns INPUT_ERROR before payment in a single check, or as an item error in a paid batch. Replay the same request with the same idempotency_key to retrieve the stored receipt without a new payment.
name: check_payment_recipient
